description: OBSERVED: bond stacks and Treasury doc scale up and slide into place on white; newspaper reader and globe slide in from lower-right corner by f56. INFERRED: builds toward the composition of next_state.

OBSERVED: same layout as end of U001 (bonds/Treasury doc/globe/newspaper reader static); a stick-figure character enters from lower-left and a calendar icon appears by f76. INFERRED: same composition as prev_state.
OBSERVED: debt-counter web banner (National Debt $40.0T) slides down from top and settles right; two/three stick characters static left. INFERRED: banner entrance onto existing character scene.
OBSERVED: Treasury seal static; The Hill headline card slides in from right and settles; a green Treasury doc drawing pops in at f229. INFERRED: items assemble into next_state composition.

OBSERVED: 3D red heart rotating and opening into two halves revealing bond icons and text 'Bond market my beloved'; green US map character slides in from bottom-left by f411. Heart rotation looks continuous but only 6 samples over 67 frames.
OBSERVED: row of green country-map characters (USA UK France etc.) near static f822-824; Canada map character appears at f825. Only 4 frames.
OBSERVED: map characters gradually zoom/scale up with Japan added at right; by f872 faces change to worried and a strip of small chart screenshots appears across top.
OBSERVED: newspaper reader with speech bubble (debt counter) and BOND icon static; red zigzag arrow draws itself rising; a stick-figure head tilts in at lower-right by f954 over the arrow.
OBSERVED: live-action/CG film clip (cartoon man with glasses next to retro TV) with caption 'Coincidence?'; character moves between samples. INFERRED: embedded meme clip.

OBSERVED: same film clip continues; caption changes to 'I THINK NOT!' and the character lunges/zooms toward camera (f1042-1049). At f1056 a hard cut to a different drawn scene (stick figure with pointer and green chalkboard), so the interval ends in a cut.

OBSERVED: static 'Government Debt Around the World in 2025' infographic with a slow scale-up/drift across samples (circle bubbles grow in frame). INFERRED: slow zoom (Ken Burns style) on still image; sparse frames.
OBSERVED: infographic zooms in and pans downward/upward-left progressively (f1352 to f1394); green character appears at lower-left at f1404. INFERRED: camera zoom/pan on still image.
OBSERVED: row of country bubbles (64% to 230%) static; red up-arrow moves leftward beneath the row from Japan to Germany across samples. INFERRED: pointer arrow stepping along row.
OBSERVED: detective stick figure with magnifier static; black circle with question mark slides in from right edge and settles.
OBSERVED: question-mark circle static with a pair of BOND papers; bond papers wobble/reorder (top paper changes) over 4 frames. Only 4 frames sampled.

OBSERVED: horizontal ticker of decade labels ('1980s -> 1990s -> 2000s -> 2010s -> 2020s') scrolling right-to-left (or left-to-right) across screen; a character with headband and glasses rises at lower-left by f1930. Starts on blank white at f1910.

OBSERVED: cartoon clip (SpongeBob at Krusty Krab with Squidward) with camera pan right to the 'Employee of the Month' wall of portraits; scene content changes across samples. INFERRED: embedded animated clip.

OBSERVED: blank white at f2233; Munder Difflin Paper Company logo card slides in from top and settles at left-centre then moves slightly right/down by f2244 (small positional shift). INFERRED: logo entrance.
OBSERVED: handwritten text types out letter by letter: 'Many years of work later' on blank white, line wraps across samples; text block repositions slightly between samples.
OBSERVED: elderly cane character and Munder Difflin logo static; money bag drops from logo down-left to rest beside character; text '$2k/month' appears at f2394.
OBSERVED: money bag + calendar icon pairs appear one after another in a row (1 to 5 pairs) over 8 frames.
OBSERVED: man with thumbs-up and pension check static; grid of green dollar bills slides in from the left and fills columns, tiling to the right behind the check, still moving at f2586.

OBSERVED: Munder Difflin logo card alone on white; shifts position slightly (small left/right jitter or drift between f2653 and f2655). No other elements in the samples. Only 6 samples over 11 frames.

OBSERVED: one BILL paper at centre with faint translucent bills; bills multiply rapidly and fill the whole frame by f2710-2714 (overlapping, some semi-transparent); at f2718 hard cut to elderly cane character on white. Interval ends in a cut.
OBSERVED: BILL papers appear one by one and pile up to the right (2 to 8+ sheets) with small rotations.
OBSERVED: man with tie and '20 years' red text static; money bags appear and grow in number (1 to 3) next to him within 7 frames.
OBSERVED: same scene as U026; money bags pile up (4 to 6) over 3 frames. Only 3 frames.
OBSERVED: pension check drawing rotates and shrinks toward the centre-left, nearly vanishing by f3222 (scale-down with tilt).

OBSERVED: stick figure in red vest falls down over a pale sky background with a dark gray structure in upper-left; red text 'IT'S NOT WORKING HELP ME AAAA' appears next to him at f3701; he leaves frame by f3715. INFERRED: character falling motion; frame sparse.
OBSERVED: Munder Difflin logo static top-left; money bag drops from the logo down and slides right to lower-right; a man stick figure appears beside the bag at f3735.

OBSERVED: two embedded panels, a 'not stonks' meme image (left, appears still) and a cartoon clip with caption 'THE ENTIRE WORLD ECONOMY IS DESTROYED.' (right, background figures shift). At f3817 a hard cut to pension check + money bag drawing. INFERRED: right panel is a video clip; left panel may be a still.
OBSERVED: pension check and money bag shrink together toward centre; by f3848 the bag has been replaced by a dollar bill beside a small check. INFERRED: shrink-and-swap sequence.
OBSERVED: line chart '30-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007' draws itself left to right, from empty axes at f4055 to a full 2007-2026 line by f4082. INFERRED: wipe reveal of an image.
OBSERVED: blank white at f4282; Investopedia 'Liability-Driven Investment (LDI)' card slides in from the left and scales up, settling at f4295.

OBSERVED: yield-formula image static on top; two stick characters (curly brown hair, blond hair) below shift pose between samples (arms move); at f4436 a hard cut to a dark-haired character with bow tie and BOND paper. Interval ends in a cut. Sparse frames limit pose assessment.
OBSERVED: BOND paper with a white jagged tear shape; the two halves drift apart/down over samples, i.e. a tearing motion.
OBSERVED: single stick figure, near-identical in all three frames; only a subtle eyebrow/face-detail difference. Too few frames to decide between a slight loop and a freeze.

OBSERVED: analog clock with hands advancing across samples; stack of money bags appears (f5065) and a LAW paper appears (f5085); a stick-figure head rises over the clock at f5125. Clock hands consistent with continuous rotation; sampling every 20 frames is sparse.
OBSERVED: Investopedia 'Pension Plan' card with green check mark; the card and check drift/shift position (left to right to left) across samples. INFERRED: small position animation.
OBSERVED: detective stick figure static; question-mark black circle drops in from top and settles at right-middle.
OBSERVED: question-mark circle with BOND papers; bond papers reorder/shift (top paper swaps) across 4 frames. Matches U015 pattern. Only 4 frames.
OBSERVED: question-mark circle fades from black to transparent over about 17 frames while the detective figure stays static.
OBSERVED: figure inside laptop video-player frame is overlaid by dark/grey bars that grow and resolve to a black play triangle at f5505; laptop frame static. INFERRED: swap to a play-button graphic.
OBSERVED: analog clock hands sweep while text 'words per minute' types out beside it; at f5694 hard cut to a frowning character at a laptop desk. Interval ends in a cut.

OBSERVED: laptop-screen scene with a 'Turbo Type' typing-game screen recording (typed text grows and a small car advances) while black curved strokes sweep in from lower-right/left; at f5877 a cut to a smiling character. INFERRED: screen recording embedded in laptop; sampling every ~30 frames is sparse for the black strokes.
OBSERVED: smiling character static; keyboard icon flies up and over from behind his head to the right then off-screen to the left edge, rotating as it goes.

OBSERVED: 'Wispr Flow' header with two email/compose screenshots side by side; right panel text types in ('Thanks for hopping q') with timers ('00:29' to '00:30', '2 min 37 secs'); layout pans/zooms left and a green check appears at f6358. INFERRED: screen recording with camera move.

OBSERVED: 'Wispr Flow' header over a document ('Notes from the call with Ananya' list); view zooms in and left panel slides to fill the screen; green check at f6617. INFERRED: camera zoom on screenshot.
